newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh, China to jointly set up cement plant.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh, China to jointly set up cement plant.

text.p: Bangladesh and China will jointly set up a $15 million cement plant in Bangladesh's southeastern Chittagong district, company officials said on Wednesday.

Bangladesh's private sector Apex Weaving & Finishing Mills Ltd (Apex) and China National Metals and Minerals Import & Export Corporation (Minmetals - Beijing) signed a deal on March 11 in Beijing for the 300,000 tonne annual capacity plant.

The joint venture company has been named Minapex Cement Limited in which the Chaina's Minmetals will have 56 percent share and Apex the rest. The plant will be operational by September 1998, they said.
